g.title: BAT
g.text: XT60 or XT90; BMS rated 40 A continuous or more

g.title: SW1
g.text: XT90-S anti-spark loop key, rated 40 A DC or more

g.title: BUS_24V
g.text: Battery after the main switch (not cut by the E-stop)

g.title: K1
g.text: Altran ALEV50-C, 50 A DC contacts, 24 V coil, 6 W
1N4007 flyback diode across the coil (cathode to COIL+)

g.title: BUS_MOT
g.text: Motor rail 24 V (after K1, cut by the E-stop)

g.title: ES1
g.text: Opens the K1 coil circuit; switches only the coil current (0.25 A)

g.title: DC19
g.text: 20-30 V in, 19 V out, 40 W min
Keeps the Jetson stable when motors dip the battery

g.title: W_JETSON
g.text: DC barrel plug (check carrier board size)

g.title: DC5
g.text: 20-30 V in, 5 V out, 3 A min

g.title: LEDS
g.text: Seeed Grove WS2813 strip, 30 LEDs, 5 V, 1.8 A max

g.title: LIDAR
g.text: Via its USB adapter; use the adapter's aux power port if the motor won't spin up

g.title: PICO
g.text: Signal wiring in a separate diagram (pin map TBD)

g.title: MD_L
g.text: Motor stall (21 A) exceeds 13 A continuous; limit in firmware

g.title: W_M_L
g.text: Solder or crimp to the motor's copper tabs

g.title: F_MD_L
g.text: 15 A, 32 V DC (ATO blade, time delay)
Littelfuse 0287015.PXCN in holder 0FHA0002ZXJ. On the left motor lead (MA to M+), so it carries the motor current. Protects MD10C left; passes starts and short peaks, blows on a held stall (21 A)

g.title: M_L
g.text: E-S Motor 36PG-555K-24120-100, 24 V, 120 RPM, 2.6 A rated, 21 A stall
No encoder; odometry comes from the LiDAR

g.title: MD_R
g.text: Motor stall (21 A) exceeds 13 A continuous; limit in firmware

g.title: W_M_R
g.text: Solder or crimp to the motor's copper tabs

g.title: F_MD_R
g.text: 15 A, 32 V DC (ATO blade, time delay)
Littelfuse 0287015.PXCN in holder 0FHA0002ZXJ. On the right motor lead (MA to M+), so it carries the motor current. Protects MD10C right; passes starts and short peaks, blows on a held stall (21 A)

g.title: M_R
g.text: E-S Motor 36PG-555K-24120-100, 24 V, 120 RPM, 2.6 A rated, 21 A stall
No encoder; odometry comes from the LiDAR

g.title: DC12
g.text: 20-30 V in, 12 V out, 6 A min
After the E-stop, so the E-stop stops the arm; 6 A covers both arm motors starting or stalled at once (2 x 3 A)

g.title: AD
g.text: VM 4.5-13.5 V (15 V abs. max), 1.0 A per channel continuous, 3.2 A peak (10 ms)
12 V arm rail only; logic VCC 3.3 V from the Pico; firmware caps PWM duty and detects stalls

g.title: AM_1
g.text: Yahboom MD520Z19 (JGB37-520), 12 V, 550 RPM, 0.3 A rated, 3 A stall
Hall encoder (3.3 V, 11 ppr) wires to the Pico

g.title: AM_2
g.text: Yahboom MD520Z19 (JGB37-520), 12 V, 550 RPM, 0.3 A rated, 3 A stall
Hall encoder (3.3 V, 11 ppr) wires to the Pico

g.title: DRV_1
g.text: 100 uF 50 V cap across VMOT-GND; current limit 1.2-1.5 A

g.title: W_ST_1
g.text: Check coil pairs on the motor datasheet

g.title: DRV_2
g.text: 100 uF 50 V cap across VMOT-GND; current limit 1.2-1.5 A

g.title: W_ST_2
g.text: Check coil pairs on the motor datasheet

g.title: MOSFET
g.text: PWM gate signal from Pico (signal diagram)
